title: Understanding the Equations
text: The equations represent the optimization problems for finding the coefficients in linear regression. The first equation uses the original design matrix, while the second uses the mean-centered design matrix.

title: Mean of Residuals
text: In ordinary least squares regression, the mean of the residuals is always zero when an intercept is included in the model.

title: Effect of Centering
text: Centering the data does not affect the mean of the residuals. It only affects the interpretation of the intercept term.
